summary: Nintendo's detective visual novel duology, with classic Famicom Disk System originals, Japanese Virtual Console reissues, and modern Nintendo Switch remakes.

entries.title: Famicom Detective Club: The Girl Who Stands Behind
entries.definitive_edition: Famicom Detective Club: The Girl Who Stands Behind (Nintendo Switch, 2021)

emulation.notes: Use the official Switch release for the main run. Classic FDS/GBA/Virtual Console versions are only needed for historical comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official Switch remake presentation, docked HD capture

primary.version: 2021 MAGES remake, standalone or bundled with the other Famicom Detective Club remake
primary.why: The original Famicom Detective Club case and the 2021 Nintendo Switch remake both exist; the Switch release is modernized with updated visuals, fully voiced cutscenes, and English on-screen text. The Switch remake is therefore the highest-fidelity and most accessible complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the official Nintendo Switch release, standalone or from the two-game bundle. Use docked output for clean capture, English on-screen text, and Japanese voiceover; keep Famicom/GBA/Virtual Console versions only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch release uses Japanese voiceover with English on-screen text and modernizes presentation while retaining menu-driven investigation structure. Older Famicom, GBA, and Virtual Console releases remain useful only for historical comparison.
